blockers.message: sans ground truth is not fully resolved for detection-delay/missed-event/false-escalation scoring. An event flagged with unknown onset, or no event-occurrence model at all, must never be scored as healthy, detected, or a valid zero.

sans has no implemented physiological progression model (sans_physiological_progression=blocked_missing_model_rule). The synthetic event FLAG (ground truth) existing is not the same thing as an OBSERVABLE measurement signal existing - no code path superimposes an event signal onto the flat/noisy baseline every astronaut currently receives, so there is nothing for the monitoring engine to detect even when onset timing is fully known.

monitoring.engine has no authorized evidence-to-probability/tier rule for sans (MONITORING_PROBABILITY_IMPLEMENTED). Even a perfect measurement would have no way to become a Repeat/Consult/Urgent escalation tied to that evidence.

venous ground truth is not fully resolved for detection-delay/missed-event/false-escalation scoring. An event flagged with unknown onset, or no event-occurrence model at all, must never be scored as healthy, detected, or a valid zero.

venous has no implemented physiological progression model (jugular_scan_values=blocked_missing_model_rule). The synthetic event FLAG (ground truth) existing is not the same thing as an OBSERVABLE measurement signal existing - no code path superimposes an event signal onto the flat/noisy baseline every astronaut currently receives, so there is nothing for the monitoring engine to detect even when onset timing is fully known.

venous evaluation requires ALL THREE of an approved event-occurrence model, an approved onset model, and an implemented measurement-generation chain - current status: {'event_occurrence_model_approved': False, 'onset_model_approved': False, 'measurement_generation_implemented': False}. Missing: ['event_occurrence_model_approved', 'onset_model_approved', 'measurement_generation_implemented'].
